samples.question: The picture shows four coloured dots - red, green, blue and orange - and several black outlines. Every outline is a closed loop, no two outlines cross or touch, and some outlines enclose no dot at all. The depth of a dot is the number of outlines that enclose it; a dot lying outside every outline has depth 0. Exactly one dot has the greatest depth. Which coloured dot has the greatest depth? Answer red, green, blue or orange.
